manifests.tenantProgramScope: No tenant. `apps/web/scripts/seed.mjs` creates synthetic institutions on a throwaway database.
manifests.awsPartitionAccountRegionCell: NONE — an engineer's machine and a `postgres:16` container on :5433 (CLAUDE.md). No AWS partition, account, region or cell is allocated.
manifests.ownerSeat: The engineer running it. There is no durable seat; the environment lives and dies with the shell.
manifests.creationReason: Per-engineer development and unit tests, per CLAUDE.md's `docker run … tenure-pg` block.
manifests.expiry: Ephemeral. `docker rm -f tenure-pg` ends it; nothing schedules that.
manifests.releaseDigest: NONE — the app runs from source through `npm run dev`. No image is built, so no digest exists to record.
manifests.iacVersion: NONE — no Terraform is applied for this class.
manifests.databaseConfigSchemaVersions: Whatever `npx prisma migrate deploy` leaves in `apps/web/prisma/migrations/`.
manifests.explicitProhibitedData: Any production extract. §4.3's exception workflow has no path that ends on an engineer's machine.
manifests.identityIssuer: NextAuth 5 with the credentials path, against the local database.
manifests.networkEgressAllowlist: Unrestricted — the host's network. This is why the data ceiling is synthetic.
manifests.kmsKeys: NONE — no AWS keys are reachable from this class.
manifests.costBudget: $0 cloud spend. The cost is the engineer's machine.
manifests.scheduleScaleToZeroPolicy: Manual. The container runs while the engineer runs it.
manifests.destructionRules: Delete the container and the volume; no evidence of destruction is retained because nothing sensitive entered.
manifests.entryCriteria: `npm install` and a reachable Postgres on :5433.
manifests.exitCriteria: NONE — nothing promotes out of this class except a commit, which leaves through CI.
manifests.healthChecks: `npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test --workspace apps/web -- --ci` (CLAUDE.md).
manifests.responsibleApprovers: The engineer. §4.1 gives this class `Developer` promotion authority.

manifests.destructionRules: Deleting the role and the GitHub environment. `tests/security/oidc-trust.test.mjs` asserts the declaration and `roles.tf` agree.

manifests.tenantProgramScope: The live pilot carrying real student data. Pooled cell: `tenure:tenant = tenure:shared` (`infrastructure/terraform/main.tf`).
manifests.awsPartitionAccountRegionCell: aws partition; account from the OIDC role; region `secrets.AWS_REGION || 'us-east-1'`; the pooled cell — one VPC, one database, one service.
manifests.ownerSeat: Held in `Tenurework/Tenure`, not here. This repository holds the manifest and the disarmed workflow.
manifests.creationReason: The live pilot. This repository is the canonical monorepo (ADR-0005) and remains disarmed until cutover completes.
manifests.iacVersion: Terraform `>= 1.7`, `hashicorp/aws ~> 5.0`; ECS, RDS, CloudFront, ACM, SES, SQS under `infrastructure/terraform/`.
manifests.explicitProhibitedData: Nothing may leave to a non-production class without §4.3's exception workflow, which this repository has not implemented (EXT-020-005).
manifests.identityIssuer: NextAuth 5 for tenant users; GitHub OIDC for deployment.
manifests.secretsNamespace: AWS Secrets Manager `${local.name_prefix}/app`; the ECS secrets policy `${local.name_prefix}-ecs-secrets`.
manifests.integrations: SES for mail, SQS for queues, ElastiCache, RDS — all in `infrastructure/terraform/`.
manifests.destructionRules: None. Offboarding a live pilot is a program decision, not an environment rule.
manifests.entryCriteria: A push to `main` of `Tenurework/Tenure`. From this repository the guard makes that impossible, deliberately.
manifests.exitCriteria: Cutover to this repository, after which `Tenurework/Tenure` becomes the rollback source only (ADR-0005).
manifests.responsibleApprovers: Protected production authority, held outside this repository.
